description: Na₂Y₂B₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.52 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.40 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) B-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OY₄ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Y and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Y and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, three Y, and one B atom.
